meta.title: Exploring the Enchanting Ancient Temples of My Son Sanctuary
meta.description:
We spent a day exploring the ancient ruins of My Son, a religious temple complex constructed by a once mighty Kingdom that ruled much of central and southern Vietnam.

comments.author: @388_days
comments.text:
We are learning a lot about the history of Vietnam, which is not really taught in America schools. I picked up a couple of books so I could learn a bit about the history before we visited. I didn’t realize how many different groups of people inhabited the area we now know as Vietnam and how many battles were fought to control the land. I was also very surprised to learn that the Cham people were Hindu but later many turned to the Muslim faith. As we travel around we are humbled by how little we know about much of the world. Hopefully we will see peaceful times ahead for Vietnam and its neighbors. The people are so kind and respectful. 

-Chris
